lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: Rapi, stop them! Don't let them through!

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: Roger.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: Rio, are you okay?

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: They blew off one of my legs!

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: Hold on, I'm coming!

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: Rapi, cover me!

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: Roger. I'll keep an eye on the Rapture heading in that direction.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: Much appreciated.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: He... hehe... What lovely reassurance.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: We raised a good student.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: Phew... We nearly bought the farm back there.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: You said the same thing yesterday.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: All joking aside, Raptures these days are no joke.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: They're getting stronger, and faster.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: That's true... It might not be possible to beat them with our current weapons before long.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: Are the Raptures evolving?

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: What kinda crackpot theory is that? How could a bucket of bolts like those things evolve?

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: Ordinarily, I'd agree with you, but I think at this point it's undeniable.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: I'm not sure if evolution is the right term, but they're absolutely getting stronger.

lines.speaker: newbiecommander
lines.text: If you're all done with maintenance, we're moving on to the next operation area.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: I'm not done yet.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: I'm still putting my leg back together.

lines.speaker: newbiecommander
lines.text: Hurry it up, for crying out loud. If we're late, it's your fault.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: No, that would be your fault, you jackass. Not mine.

lines.speaker: newbiecommander
lines.text: What did you say?

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: You heard me.

lines.speaker: newbiecommander
lines.text: ... H-hurry up. We need to get a move on.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: Yeah yeah.
The new Commander exchanges a few nervous glances before leaving.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: It's people like him that are causing us to go through such a rough patch.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: ... I can't deny that.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: The switch from having our own squad leader to a human Commander

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: has muddled the chain of command, and resulted in more casualties.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: How long has it been?

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: Two weeks.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: Only two weeks have passed, and we've already gone through three Commanders?

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: Correct.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: ... Is this only happening to us?

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: No. It's the same everywhere else.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: What a load of crap this is.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: Hehe, I agree with you there.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: With that being said, I think they'll be doing away with the Commander system soon enough.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: The fatality rate amongst the Commanders is so high that there won't be many officers left in the Ark before long.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: These higher-ups don't have the slightest clue what they're doing.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: Okay, at one point in time, there was a legendary Commander who was absolutely incredible.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: But how many times do we have to keep failing before they get it through their skulls that this system doesn't work?

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: How long are they going to keep trying to ram these Commanders down our throats?

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: If they're so desperate for qualified Commanders, why don't they build some kind of military academy?

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: These are just rumors,

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: but there is apparently a squad with a human Commander who is performing extraordinarily well.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: I believe he's called New Hope.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: He's the reason the higher-ups continue to enforce this Commander system.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: That's not the only thing they're experimenting with.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: They're also trying out all manner of different engagement tactics in different locations.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: Why would they be doing that?

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: The answer lies in another rumor that's been going around.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: Do you always spend your entire day gossiping?

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: I heard the Central Government is preparing for a second offensive to reclaim the surface.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: One 100 times larger in scale than the first offensive.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: Did you say 100?

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: A-again, it's just a rumor at this point.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: ... But I do think it's possible.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: That would explain why they are experimenting with different tactics.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: If they're preparing for all-out war, they'd want to collect as much practical data as possible.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: War...

lines.speaker: newbiecommander
lines.text: Hey! Hurry up and move!

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: Yeah yeah, we're going.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: I hope that punk gets what he deserves out there.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: Don't joke about that kind of thing.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: Who says I'm joking?

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: I understand why you feel that way.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: Let's get this over with and head back.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: There's a concert tomorrow, so I've got plans lined up from morning onwards.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: Pretty?

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: You bet.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: I heard she was in a bit of a creative slump. Is she back?

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: What are you talking about? She was never in a slump.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: Hehe, right. My apologies.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: You guys wanna come? I heard entry is free.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: No thanks.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: I'm also not interested.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: Hmph. You guys are boring.
Next day. Nikke dormitory.
Rapi examines her equipment prior to being deployed.
Wendi lies on the bed playing with her phone.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: Are you getting ready already?

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: How come you're always so on top of things?

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: It's easier this way.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: How long has it been since you joined us, Rapi?

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: Three years.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: That long? Time really flies.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: It's been a while since I've asked you, but...

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: Have you discovered what it is you want to do?

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: No. Not yet.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: ... I see.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: Well, I should start getting ready...
Wendi suddenly bolts upright, leaping off the bed with startling speed.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: Rapi! Rapi!

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: Have you read the Ark Daily today?!

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: No, not yet. What is it?

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: Pretty is dead!

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: She was murdered by a Nikkephobia in the middle of her comeback concert.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: What about Rio?

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: I'll contact her.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: The last message I got from her was that she'd arrived at the concert...

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: I'm here.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: R-Rio!

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: A-are you okay?

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: Pretty, she...

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: Oh. That.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: I'm okay.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: Too bad about her dying.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: She died so easily.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: It was hard to believe she was even a Nikke.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: Rio...

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: Oh, Rapi.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: It's been a while since I gave you a lesson. Here's one more thing.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: There's no point in trying so hard.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: None of it matters when you die.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: You can strive to be the best in life, inspire countless people, and give them hope...

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: And it all amounts to nothing in the end.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: Life is meaningless.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: It doesn't matter how hard you try. If some crazy person intent on ending your life comes after you, it's all over in an instant.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: So what's the point?

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: No need to put so much effort into living.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: Rio.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: No matter how much you strive to achieve,

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: how brightly you shine, how beautiful you are,

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: all someone has to do is lift a finger,

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: and your life ceases to exist.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: So don't bother trying.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: It's all meaningless.
Wendi approaches Rio and embraces her.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: I'm sorry, Rio.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: What's wrong? I'm okay.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: You're clearly not okay, Rio.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: It's all so meaningless... What's the point of living?

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: Why did Pretty work so hard to achieve everything she did?

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: All it did was get her killed.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: That's not true.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: I didn't know Pretty personally,

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: but I'm sure the reason she worked as hard as she did was because she was striving towards something.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: But we'll never find out what that something was,

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: and it's not like she'll ever get there anyway. Not anymore.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: It's better to give up on any dreams or aspirations you have.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: It all amounts to nothing when you're gone.
A few days later.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: Rio, did you want to become like Pretty?

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: No. I wanted to become a pop star like her, yes, but not Pretty specifically.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: What? Is that so hard to believe?

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: So, it was more than just liking her music, huh?

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: Okay, so I dreamed of becoming like her. Is that not allowed?

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: ... Even though I never made any concrete steps towards that dream.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: It all ended so suddenly anyway.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: A dream that died before it even began.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: Rapi.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: Mmm.
Rapi hands Rio an envelope with extravagant patterning.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: What's this?

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: It's a ticket to partake in an audition to be the next Tetra pop star.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: Rapi and I had to pull some serious strings in order to get that.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: But these... these are so sought after you can't even pay for them...

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: Everything has a price.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: We found a way to purchase it.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: ... How much did you pay?

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: In a situation like this, I think it would be better for you to simply say thank you rather than ask how much.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: Pfft!

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: I-I can't do this. I haven't even practiced, let alone gotten into the right headspace. I don't have any outfits, and...

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: Well, you can start now. The audition is in three months.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: I'll be rooting for you.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: I want you to show me that

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: hard work pays off.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: I'm sure you will learn a lot.

lines.speaker: wendi
lines.text: Think of this as being like one of the lessons we gave Rapi. Now, go get 'em.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: O-okay.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: I'll try my best.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: rio
lines.text: Thank you so much!
Rio continuously hums a song by Pretty throughout her mission.
Despite multiple warnings by the new commander to stay quiet, Rio pays him no mind and continues humming.
Even when he begins harassing her, Rio shrugs off the remarks and continues undeterred.
That night.
Rio, her eyes crimson red, fires upon her squadmates as she hums Pretty's song.
After Wendi is forced to shoot down Rio, she smiles briefly and then turns the gun on herself.
The gunshots draw in nearby Raptures, and a battle breaks out.
The Commander dies in the skirmish, and only two members of the squad are left standing.
Rapi and the other survivor return to the Ark.
Rapi is put on standby after a routine checkup.
There is a warning on the news cautioning the public against fake Tetra Nikke audition tickets which are circulating.

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: Wha...

lines.speaker: rapi_m
lines.text: No... no...
The Skull Head Squad is disbanded due to the members being killed in action.
Rapi begins to understand what Rio meant by life being meaningless.
Rapi looks at the mirror.
In her reflection,
she sees the same expression Rio has shown on the day Pretty died.
She feels empty.
